item.title: Lake Howell, OCP savor FHSAA boys basketball district titles
item.description: Lake Howell knocked off third-ranked Mainland in boys basketball to win the SilverHawks first district championship in 18 years. “These kids deserve this,” coach Mike Sutton said. “Our school deserves this. We built this program back up brick by brick and it feels fantastic.”

item.title: Orlando high school scores and statistics from Friday, Feb. 6
item.description: Josh Theus had 22 points for OCP in a boys hoops district title win. Anai Braxton had 16 points for Foundation Academy girls in a win. Other girls basketball district winners included Lake Highland, Ocoee, MDCA, Wekiva and Bishop Moore.
